57600.meaning1: worth one hundred thousand times more; one hundred thousand times more valuable

examples.text: tatr'ānanda, tiracchānagate dānaṃ datvā sataguṇā dakkhiṇā pāṭikaṅkhitabbā, puthujjanadussīle dānaṃ datvā sahassaguṇā dakkhiṇā pāṭikaṅkhitabbā, puthujjanasīlavante dānaṃ datvā satasahassaguṇā dakkhiṇā pāṭikaṅkhitabbā

57601.commentary: (SNa) satimaṃ kalan'ti mahāpathaviyā paṃsuṃ satakoṭṭhāse katvā tato ekakoṭṭhāsaṃ. parato'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: n'eva satimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti purimaṃ dukkhakkhandhaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādiṇṇaṃ upanidhāya yadidaṃ sattakkhattuṃparamatā.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, nikkhaṃ jambonadaṃ dakkha-kammāraputta-ukkāmukha-sukusala-sampahaṭṭhaṃ paṇḍukambale nikkhittaṃ bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, satasahasso brahmā satasahassilokadhātuṃ pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
asmī'ti, bhikkhave, sati itth'asmī'ti hoti, evaṃ'smī'ti hoti, aññathā'smī'ti hoti, as'asmī'ti hoti, sat'asmī'ti hoti, santi hoti, itthaṃ santi hoti, evaṃ santi hoti, aññathā santi hoti

57604.commentary: (ANa) sīdatī'ti sataṃ, aniccass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tasmā sassatucchedavasena vuttānī'ti veditabbāni. ito parāni san'ti evam'ādīni cattāri saṃsayaparivitakkavasena vuttāni.

examples.text: asmī'ti, bhikkhave, sati itth'asmī'ti hoti, evaṃ'smī'ti hoti, aññathā'smī'ti hoti, as'asmī'ti hoti, sat'asmī'ti hoti, santi hoti, itthaṃ santi hoti, evaṃ santi hoti, aññathā santi hoti

57605.grammar: masc, dat pl of santa, irreg
57605.meaning1: for virtuous people; for good people

examples.text: ovadeyy'ānusāseyya, asabbhā ca nivāraye, satañ'hi so piyo hoti, asataṃ hoti appiyo.
ye puggalā aṭṭha sataṃ pasatthā, cattāri etāni yugāni honti, te dakkhiṇeyyā sugatassa sāvakā, etesu dinnāni mahapphalāni, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

57606.grammar: masc, gen pl of santa, irreg
57606.meaning1: of virtuous people; of good people; of wise people; of sages

examples.text: na pupphagandho paṭivātam'eti, na candanaṃ tagaramallikā, satañ'ca gandho paṭivātam'eti, sabbā disā sappuriso pavāyati.
yaṃ kiñci dhammam'abhijaññā, ajjhattaṃ athavā'pi bahiddhā, na tena thāmaṃ kubbetha, na hi sā nibbuti sataṃ vuttā.

57607.grammar: prp, masc gen pl of santa, intrans

examples.text: tatr'āvuso, yv'āyaṃ puggalo sāṅgaṇo'va samāno atthi me ajjhattaṃ aṅgaṇan'ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, ayaṃ imesaṃ dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ sāṅgaṇānaṃ'y'eva sataṃ hīnapuriso akkhāyati.

57608.grammar: prp, masc gen pl of santa, gen abs, intrans
57608.meaning1: when they exist; when existing; when we were

examples.text: tesaṃ vo, bhikkhave, evaṃsamaññānaṃ sataṃ evaṃpaṭiññānaṃ sataṃ, yā samaṇasāmīcippaṭipadā taṃ paṭipajjissāma. evaṃ no ayaṃ amhākaṃ samaññā ca saccā bhavissati paṭiññā ca bhūtā.
tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, setughāto gīte, setughāto nacce, alaṃ vo dhammappamoditānaṃ sataṃ sitaṃ sitamattāyā'ti.

57609.grammar: prp, masc dat pl of santa, intrans

57610.grammar: prp, masc instr sg of santa, intrans (+nom)

examples.text: santi kho pana, sāriputta, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, yaññena suddhī'ti. na kho pana so, sāriputta, yañño sulabharūpo yo mayā ayiṭṭhapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā, tañ'ca kho raññā vā satā khattiyena muddh'āvasittena brāhmaṇena vā mahāsālena.
atthi idappaccayā phasso'ti iti puṭṭhena satā, ānanda, atthītissa vacanīyaṃ. kiṃpaccayā phasso'ti iti ce vadeyya, nāmarūpapaccayā phasso'ti icc'assa vacanīyaṃ.

57611.meaning1: ruled by mindfulness; governed by awareness; (or) having mindfulness as controlling influence
57611.commentary: (ANa) jeṭṭhakaṭṭhena sati adhipati etesan'ti sat'ādhipateyyā, satijeṭṭhakā'ti attho.

examples.text: te pana, samiddhi, kiṃadhipateyyā'ti? sat'ādhipateyyā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃuttarā'ti? paññ'uttarā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃsārā'ti? vimuttisārā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃogadhā'ti? amat'ogadhā, bhante'ti.
samādhippamukhā sabbe dhammā, sat'ādhipateyyā sabbe dhammā, paññ'uttarā sabbe dhammā, vimuttisārā sabbe dhammā, amat'ogadhā sabbe dhammā, nibbānapariyosānā sabbe dhammā'ti.

57612.meaning1: knowledge based on memory; understanding from recollection

examples.text: atītaṃ kho, cunda, addhānaṃ ārabbha tathāgatassa sat'ānusāriñāṇaṃ hoti, so yāvatakaṃ ākaṅkhati tāvatakaṃ anussarati.

57613.meaning1: following the memory; coming after the recollection
57613.commentary: (MNa) sat'ānusāriviññāṇan'ti na'y'idaṃ bodhāya maggo bhavissati, ān'āpānassatipaṭhamajjhānaṃ pana bhavissatī'ti evaṃ ekaṃ dve vāre uppannasatiyā anantaraṃ uppannaviññāṇaṃ sat'ānusāriviññāṇaṃ nāma.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, sat'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ ahosi, es'eva maggo bodhāyā'ti

57614.meaning1: protected by mindfulness; guarded by awareness
57614.commentary: (DNa) sat'ārakkhena cetasā'ti khīṇ'āsavassa hi tīsu dvāresu sabbakālaṃ sati ārakkhakiccaṃ sādheti. ten'ev'assa carato ca tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hotī'ti vuccati.

examples.text: etha tumhe, āvuso, indriyesu guttadvārā viharatha ārakkhasatino nipakasatino, sārakkhitamānasā sat'ārakkhena cetasā samannāgatā'ti

57615.meaning1: memory; remembering; recollection; keeping in mind

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, dhammā kāyena sacchikaraṇīyā, atthi, bhikkhave, dhammā satiyā sacchikaraṇīyā, atthi, bhikkhave, dhammā cakkhunā sacchikaraṇīyā, atthi, bhikkhave, dhammā paññāya sacchikaraṇīyā.
katame ca, bhikkhave, dhammā satiyā sacchikaraṇīyā? pubbenivāso, bhikkhave, satiyā sacchikaraṇīyo.
satiñ'ca khv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sabb'atthikaṃ vadāmī'ti.
yāni sotāni lokasmiṃ, sati tesaṃ nivāraṇaṃ, sotānaṃ saṃvaraṃ brūmi, paññāy'ete pidhiyyare.

57617.grammar: prp, masc loc sg of santa, loc abs, intrans

examples.text: ko nu hāso kim'ānando, niccaṃ pajjalite sati, andhakārena onaddhā, padīpaṃ na gavesatha.
attani vā, bhikkhave, sati attaniyaṃ me'ti assā'ti? evaṃ, bhante. attaniye vā, bhikkhave, sati attā me'ti assā'ti? evaṃ, bhante.

katamo ca, bhikkhave, sappurisena sappurisataro? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco… attanā ca upaṭṭhitassati hoti, parañ'ca satiupaṭṭhāne samādapeti, attanā ca paññāsampanno hoti, parañ'ca paññāsampadāya samādapeti.

57619.meaning1: one hundred; consisting of one hundred; amounting to one hundred

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo mithilāyaṃ paṭivasati jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto, vīsavassasatiko jātiyā, tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū
santi mahāsamudde yojanasatikā'pi attabhāvā, dviyojanasatikā'pi attabhāvā, tiyojanasatikā'pi attabhāvā, catuyojanasatikā'pi attabhāvā, pañcayojanasatikā'pi attabhāvā

57620.meaning1: paying attention; being mindful; keeping in mind
57620.commentary: (MNa) satikaraṇīyam'eva hotī'ti etā gāvo'ti satiuppādanamattam'eva kātabbaṃ hoti. ito c'ito ca gantvā ākoṭan'ādikiccaṃ n'atthi.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gimhānaṃ pacchime māse sabbasassesu gām'antasambhatesu gopālako gāvo rakkheyya, tassa rukkhamūlagatassa vā abbhokāsagatassa vā satikaraṇīyam'eva hoti, etā gāvo'ti.

57621.meaning1: full of grass, wood and water
57621.compound: dvanda > bahubbīhi (satiṇa ca sakaṭṭha ca saudaka ca)
57621.commentary: (MNa) yasmā pana so gāmo bahi āvijjhitvā jātena hatthi-ass'ādīnaṃ ghāsatiṇena c'eva gehacchadanatiṇena ca sampanno, tathā dārukaṭṭhehi c'eva gehasambhārakaṭṭhehi ca, yasmā c'assa abbhantare vaṭṭacaturass'ādisaṇṭhānā bahū pokkharaṇiyo, jalajakusumavicittāni ca bahi anekāni taḷākāni vā udakassa niccabharitāneva honti, tasmā satiṇakaṭṭh'odakan'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena caṅkī brāhmaṇo opāsādaṃ ajjhāvasati satt'ussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭh'odakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.

57622.meaning1: prudent mindfulness; careful awareness; (comm) mindfulness and prudence
57622.commentary: (DNa) satinepakke'ti satiyañ'c'eva nepakkabhāve ca. (SNa) satinepakkenā'ti ettha nipakassa bhāvo nepakkaṃ, paññāy'etaṃ nāmaṃ.

examples.text: saddhassa hi, bhante, ariyasāvakassa āraddhavīriyassa etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ satimā bhavissati, paramena satinepakkena samannāgato, cirakatam'pi cirabhāsitam'pi saritā anussaritā.

57623.meaning1: faculty of awareness; power of presence

examples.text: aparāni'pi pañc'indriyāni saddh'indriyaṃ vīriy'indriyaṃ sat'indriyaṃ samādh'indriyaṃ paññ'indriyaṃ
tassa cittaṃ rakkhato āsavesu ca sāsavesu ca dhammesu… sat'indriyam'pi bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati. samādh'indriyam'pi bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.

57625.meaning1: attending mindfully; being present with mindfulness

examples.text: sambahulā bhikkhuniyo catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu suppatiṭṭhitacittā viharantiyo
yā kho, āvuso visākha, cittassa ek'aggatā ayaṃ samādhi, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā samādhinimittā, cattāro sammappadhānā samādhiparikkhārā.

57626.meaning1: attending mindfully; being present with mindfulness

examples.text: attānaṃ, bhikkhave, rakkhissāmī'ti satipaṭṭhānaṃ sevitabbaṃ, paraṃ rakkhissāmī'ti satipaṭṭhānaṃ sevitabbaṃ. attānaṃ, bhikkhave, rakkhanto paraṃ rakkhati, paraṃ rakkhanto attānaṃ rakkhatī'ti.

57627.meaning1: development of attending mindfully; cultivation of being present with mindfulness

examples.text: evarūpañ'hi jānanaṃ satt'ūpaladdhiṃ na pajahati, attasaññaṃ na ugghāṭeti, kammaṭṭhānaṃ vā satipaṭṭhānabhāvanā vā na hoti. imassa pana bhikkhuno jānanaṃ satt'ūpaladdhiṃ pajahati, attasaññaṃ ugghāṭeti, kammaṭṭhānañ'c'eva satipaṭṭhānabhāvanā ca hoti.

57628.meaning1: leading to the development of attending mindfully

examples.text: satipaṭṭhānañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi satipaṭṭhānabhāvanañ'ca satipaṭṭhānabhāvanāgāminiñ'ca paṭipadaṃ. taṃ suṇātha.

57635.meaning1: observing the ways of attending mindfully

examples.text: akammaṃ h'etaṃ, mahārāja, jinaputtānaṃ yadidaṃ pūjā, sammasanaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ, yoniso manasikāro, satipaṭṭhān'ānupassanā, ārammaṇasāraggāho, kilesayuddhaṃ, sadattham'anuyuñjanā, etaṃ jinaputtānaṃ karaṇīyaṃ, avasesānaṃ devamanussānaṃ pūjā karaṇīyā.
sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā, pubb'eva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamā, adukkham'asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.

57637.meaning1: power that is awareness; strength of mindfulness

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, udāyi, akkhātā mayā sāvakānaṃ paṭipadā, yathāpaṭipannā me sāvakā pañca balāni bhāventi. idh'udāyi, bhikkhu satibalaṃ bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ. tatra ca pana me sāvakā bahū abhiññāvosānapāramippattā viharanti.

57638.meaningLit: discourse on the strength of mindfulness

57639.commentary: (SNa) satimaṃ kalan'ti mahāpathaviyā paṃsuṃ satakoṭṭhāse katvā tato ekakoṭṭhāsaṃ. parato'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: n'eva satimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti purimaṃ dukkhakkhandhaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādiṇṇaṃ upanidhāya yadidaṃ sattakkhattuṃparamatā.
avitakkomhi avicāro ajjhattaṃ satimā sukham'asmī'ti pajānāti
ākiñcaññaṃ pekkhamāno satimā, n'atthī'ti nissāya tarassu oghaṃ, kāme pahāya virato kathāhi, taṇhakkhayaṃ nattam'ah'ābhipassa.

57642.meaning1: having a good memory; with excellent recollection
57642.commentary: (MNa) evaṃ adhimattasatimanto'ti yathā so dhanuggaho taṃ vidatthicaturaṅgulachāyaṃ sīghaṃ eva atikkameti, evaṃ padasatam'pi padasahassam'pi uggahetuṃ upadhāretuṃ sajjhāyituṃ atthakāraṇāni ca upaparikkhituṃ samatthā'ti attho. (ANa) bahussutānan'ti-ādīsu aññe'pi therā bahussutā satimantā gatimantā dhitimantā upaṭṭhākā ca atthi. ayaṃ pan'āyasmā buddhavacanaṃ uggaṇhanto dasabalassa sāsane bhaṇḍ'āgārikapariyattiyaṃ ṭhatvā gaṇhi. tasmā bahussutānaṃ aggo nāma jāto. imass'eva ca therassa buddhavacanaṃ gahetvā dhāraṇakasati aññehi therehi balavatarā ahosi, tasmā satimantānaṃ aggo nāma jāto. ayam'eva c'āyasmā ekapade ṭhatvā saṭṭhi padasahassāni gaṇhanto satthārā kathitaniyāmen'eva sabbapadāni jānāti, tasmā gatimantānaṃ aggo nāma jāto.

examples.text: evaṃ adhimattasatimanto evaṃ adhimattagatimanto evaṃ adhimattadhitimanto evaṃ paramena paññāveyyattiyena samannāgatā.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ satimantānaṃ yadidaṃ ānando.

57643.grammar: prp, fem loc sg of santa, loc abs, intrans
57643.meaning1: when being present; when there is; when exists
57643.commentary: (VIN 1.4.1.3) satiyā paccāsāyā'ti paccāsā hoti saṅghato vā gaṇato vā ñātito vā mittato vā paṃsukūlaṃ vā attano vā dhanena.

examples.text: no c'assa pāripūri, māsaparamaṃ tena bhikkhunā taṃ cīvaraṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ ūnassa pāripūriyā satiyā paccāsāya. tato ce uttari nikkhipeyya satiyā'pi paccāsāya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

57645.meaning1: clear present moment awareness; mindful attentiveness

examples.text: so iminā ca ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato, imāya ca ariyāya santuṭṭhiyā samannāgato, iminā ca ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato, iminā ca ariyena satisampajaññena samannāgato vivittaṃ sen'āsanaṃ bhajiṃ
atthi, bhikkhave, samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā satisampajaññāya saṃvattati, atthi, bhikkhave, samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā āsavānaṃ khayāya saṃvattati.

57648.meaning1: due to clear present moment awareness; due to mindful attentiveness

57650.meaning1: mindfulness as an element of awakening; remembering as factor of enlightenment
57650.meaning2: self-possession as a constituent of awakening

examples.text: yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tathā vūpakaṭṭho viharanto taṃ dhammaṃ anussarati anuvitakketi, satisambojjh'aṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti, satisambojjh'aṅgaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu bhāveti, satisambojjh'aṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.
yathā ca anuppannassa satisambojjh'aṅgassa uppādo hoti tañ'ca pajānāti, yathā ca uppannassa satisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūrī hoti tañ'ca pajānāti

57651.meaning1: serving as a basis for mindfulness as an element of awakening; giving support to remembering as factor of enlightenment

examples.text: satisambojjh'aṅgaṭṭhāniyānaṃ, bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ manasikārabahulīkārā anuppanno c'eva satisambojjh'aṅgo uppajjati, uppanno ca satisambojjh'aṅgo bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati …

57652.meaning1: serving as a basis for mindfulness as an element of awakening; giving support to remembering as factor of enlightenment
57652.commentary: (SNa) satisambojjh'aṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā'ti satiyā ārammaṇadhammā sattatiṃsa bodhipakkhiyā ca nava lok'uttaradhammā ca.

examples.text: ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā satisambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā satisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? atthi, bhikkhave, satisambojjh'aṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā.

idha pan'udāyi, ekacco puggalo upadhipahānāya paṭipanno hoti upadhipaṭinissaggāya. tam'enaṃ upadhipahānāya paṭipannaṃ upadhipaṭinissaggāya kadāci karahaci satisammosā upadhipaṭisaṃyuttā sarasaṅkappā samudācaranti, dandho, udāyi, sat'uppādo.

57659.meaning1: (vinaya) verdict of awareness; settlement by mindfulness; resolution by remembering

examples.text: uppann'uppannānaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ samathāya vūpasamāya sammukhāvinayo dātabbo, sativinayo dātabbo, amūḷhavinayo dātabbo, paṭiññāya kāretabbaṃ, yebhuyyasikā, tassapāpiyasikā, tiṇ'avatthārako'ti.

57662.grammar: prp, masc loc sg of santa, loc abs, intrans

examples.text: gāth'ābhigītaṃ me abhojaneyyaṃ, sampassataṃ brāhmaṇa n'esa dhammo, gāth'ābhigītaṃ panudanti buddhā, dhamme satī brāhmaṇa vutti'r'esā.

57663.meaning1: with mindfulness; having presence; with awareness
57663.commentary: (MNa) muṭṭhā sati etesan'ti muṭṭhassatī, naṭṭhassatī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (SNa) muṭṭhassatī'ti bhattanikkhittakāko viya naṭṭhassati, idha kataṃ ettha nassati.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, brāhmaṇa, etadahosi, ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā muṭṭhassatī asampajānā araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, muṭṭhassati-asampajāna-sandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.
yathācārī yathāsato satīmā, yatasaṅkappajjhāyi appamatto, ajjhattarato samāhit'atto, eko santusito tam'āhu bhikkhuṃ.
manujassa sadā satīmato, mattaṃ jānato laddhabhojane, tanu tassa bhavanti vedanā, saṇikaṃ jīrati āyupālayan'ti.

57665.commentary: (ANa) dandho, bhikkhave, sat'uppādo'ti buddhavacan'ānussaraṇasatiyā uppādo dandho garu

examples.text: so muṭṭhassati kālaṃ kurumāno aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ upapajjati. tassa tattha sukhino dhammapadā plavanti. dandho, bhikkhave, sat'uppādo, atha so satto khippaṃ'y'eva visesagāmī hoti.

57666.meaningLit: arising of memory to be done

examples.text: na me, bhikkhave, tesu bhikkhūsu anusāsanī karaṇīyā ahosi, sat'uppādakaraṇīyam'eva me, bhikkhave, tesu bhikkhūsu ahosi.

57667.meaning1: belonging to the host of one hundred laudatory (heavenly beings)
57667.commentary: (SNa) sat'ullapakāyikā'ti sataṃ dhammaṃ samādānavasena ullapetvā sagge nibbattā'ti sat'ullapakāyikā.

examples.text: atha kho sambahulā sat'ullapakāyikā devatāyo abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.

57668.meaning2: Chapter 4 of the Devatāsaṃyuttaṃ, Book 1 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya
57668.meaningLit: section with one hundred Ullāpa devas

57669.grammar: card, nt nom sg of sata

examples.text: ek'ūnapaññāsa ājīvakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa paribbājakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa nāg'āvāsasate, vīse indriyasate, tiṃse nirayasate, chattiṃsa rajodhātuyo

57672.meaning1: what is curable and what is incurable; what is remediable and what is irremediable

57673.grammar: prp, masc gen sg of santa, gen abs, intrans
57673.meaning1: when being; when it is; when they are

examples.text: ehi tvaṃ, bhadramukha, saṅghāṭiko hohi, saṅghāṭikassa te sato saṅghāṭidhāraṇamattena abhijjhālussa abhijjhā pahīyissati
tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, āturakāyassa me sato cittaṃ anāturaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabban'ti.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññ'āgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā. so sato'va assasati sato'va passasati.
sādhu kho tvaṃ anuruddha satta mahāpurisavitakke vitakkesi
satta vassāni bhagavantaṃ, anubandhiṃ padāpadaṃ, otāraṃ n'ādhigacchissaṃ, sambuddhassa satīmato.
anicce niccasaññino, dukkhe ca sukhasaññino, anattani ca attā'ti, asubhe subhasaññino, micchādiṭṭhihatā sattā, khittacittā visaññino.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye manussesu paccājāyanti. atha kho ete'y'eva bahutarā sattā ye aññatra manussehi paccājāyanti.

57678.synonym: allīna, āsatta, lagita, lagga, laggita, visatta, saṇṭhita
57678.commentary: (SNPa) satto'ti laggo. guhāyan'ti kāye. kāyo hi rāg'ādīnaṃ vāḷānaṃ vasan'okāsato guhā'ti vuccati.

examples.text: hitvā icchañ'ca lobhañ'ca, yattha satto puthujjano, cakkhumā paṭipajjeyya, tareyya narakaṃ imaṃ.
satto guhāyaṃ bahun'ābhichanno, tiṭṭhaṃ naro mohanasmiṃ pagāḷho, dūre vivekā hi tathāvidho so, kāmā hi loke na hi suppahāyā.
ekaṃ ekakaṃ, dve dukā, tīṇi tikā, cattāri catukkā, pañca pañcakā, cha chakkā, satta sattakā, aṭṭha aṭṭhakā, nava navakā, dasa dasakā'ti, satam'pi mayaṃ, bho gotama, gaṇāpema, bhiyyo'pi gaṇāpema.
tasiṇāya purakkhatā pajā, parisappanti saso'va bandhito, saṃyojanasaṅgasattakā, dukkham'upenti punappunaṃ cirāya.

57686.meaningLit: canonical text of the book of sevens

examples.text: sikkhāpadañ'ca assaddhaṃ, sattakammaṃ atho ca dasakammaṃ, aṭṭhaṅgikañ'ca dasamaggaṃ, dve pāpadhammā apare dve'ti.

57688.meaningLit: discourse on seven courses of action

57691.meaning1: stream-enterer who has seven more lives at the most
57691.commentary: (SNa) yassa sattakkhattuṃ paramā upapatti, aṭṭhamaṃ bhavaṃ n'ādiyati, ayaṃ sattakkhattu'paramo nāma.

examples.text: taṃ vā pana anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sattakkhattu'paramo hoti, sattakkhattu'paramaṃ deve ca manusse ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhass'antaṃ karoti.

57692.meaning1: seven times at the very most; maximum of seven times

examples.text: saṅkham'pi na upeti, upanidham'pi na upeti, kalabhāgam'pi na upeti, purimaṃ dukkhakkhandhaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādinnaṃ upanidhāya yadidaṃ sattakkhattu'paramatā

57693.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of sattakkhattuparama
57693.meaning1: seven times at the most; maximum of seven times

examples.text: taṃ vā pana anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sattakkhattu'paramo hoti, sattakkhattu'paramaṃ deve ca manusse ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhass'antaṃ karoti.
taṃ vā pana anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sattakkhattu'paramo hoti, sattakkhattu'paramaṃ deve ca manusse ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhass'antaṃ karoti.
sattakkhattuṃ mahābrahmā, vasavattī tadā ahuṃ, chattiṃsakkhattuṃ dev'indo, devarajjam'akārayiṃ.

57695.meaning1: seven times at the very most; maximum of seven times

examples.text: n'eva satimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti purimaṃ dukkhakkhandhaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādiṇṇaṃ upanidhāya yadidaṃ sattakkhattuṃparamatā.

57696.meaning1: seven times at the most; maximum of seven times

examples.text: sa sattakkhattuṃparamaṃ, sandhāvitvāna puggalo, dukkhass'antakaro hoti, sabbasaṃyojanakkhayā'ti.
tīṇi malāni timalaṃ, tīṇi phalāni tiphalaṃ, tayo lokā tilokaṃ, tayo daṇḍā tidaṇḍaṃ, catasso disā catuddisaṃ, pañca indriyāni pañc'indriyaṃ, satta godāvariyo sattagodāvaraṃ.

57699.meaning1: having seven factors; endowed with seven qualities
57699.commentary: (MNa) evaṃ satt'aṅgasamannāgato'ti evaṃ imehi sattahi mahāpaccavekkhaṇañāṇehi samannāgato.

examples.text: evaṃ satt'aṅgasamannāgatassa kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa dhammatā susamanniṭṭhā hoti sot'āpattiphala-sacchikiriyāya. evaṃ satt'aṅgasamannāgato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako sot'āpattiphala-samannāgato hotī'ti.
